dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 李斌
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 我昨天加班到夜里 4 点多，我很累了，我想多休息一会不行吗？

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions, muted warm-cool palette. Eye-level medium shot tilted down about 15 degrees from a bedside-lamp angle on a 30-something East Asian Chinese man who has just sat up in bed. The navy blue duvet has slid down from his face to his chest exposing his upper body. Short black hair is completely messy from sleeping, sticking up on one side. Head still angled slightly downward looking at the bed rather than at the camera, but his mouth is open mid-speech. Eyes only half-open — eyelids loose, gaze unfocused, lashes pressed against under-eye dark circles, two-to-three-day stubble shadow visible on the jaw. Loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt collar pulled low at the neckline. Background soft-focus: crumpled navy blue duvet, white pillow. Cold white morning sunlight slanting in from the upper right (the curtain was already opened in the previous page). Mood: the first counterattack, the first time he speaks in the whole story. Text watermark 'P04-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, fully open alert eyes, smiling, tears, exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops, bright flat lighting, wife visible in frame, soft romantic mood, well-groomed hair
